# Zucker & Regev, P.C.

> Brooklyn-based medical malpractice and personal injury law firm specializing in birth injuries, traumatic brain injuries, and wrongful death cases with a physician-attorney on staff.

Zucker & Regev, P.C. is a personal injury and medical malpractice law firm located in Brooklyn, New York, led by Gary Zucker and Guy Regev (a physician-attorney). The firm has achieved multi-million dollar verdicts and settlements and focuses on complex medical negligence cases.

## Key Topics

- Medical Malpractice
- Birth Injury
- Traumatic Brain Injury
- Cerebral Palsy

## Core Services

- [Medical Malpractice Lawyer](https://www.zucker-regev.com/services/medical-malpractice-lawyer): Medical malpractice legal services featuring Guy Regev, physician-attorney.
- [Birth Injury Lawyer](https://www.zucker-regev.com/services/birth-injury-lawyer): Birth injury attorney services for cerebral palsy, brain damage, and delivery negligence.
- [Traumatic Brain Injury Lawyer](https://www.zucker-regev.com/services/traumatic-brain-injury-lawyer): Traumatic brain injury lawsuit representation and damage claims assistance.
- [Wrongful Death Lawyer](https://www.zucker-regev.com/services/wrongful-death-lawyer): Wrongful death attorney services for families of fatal accident victims.
- [Auto Accident Lawyer](https://www.zucker-regev.com/services/auto-accident-lawyer): Motor vehicle accident legal representation and insurance claim assistance.

## Specialized Medical Malpractice

- [Cerebral Palsy Lawyer](https://www.zucker-regev.com/services/cerebral-palsy-lawyer): Cerebral palsy birth injury claims from oxygen deprivation or medical negligence.
- [Erb's Palsy Lawyer](https://www.zucker-regev.com/services/erbs-palsy-lawyer): Erb's palsy birth injury claims from difficult deliveries and medical negligence.
- [Anesthesia Errors Lawyer](https://www.zucker-regev.com/services/anesthesia-errors-lawyer): Medical malpractice representation for anesthesia-related surgical errors.
- [Misdiagnosis Lawyer](https://www.zucker-regev.com/services/misdiagnosis-lawyer): Medical malpractice representation for doctor misdiagnosis and delayed diagnosis.
- [Pediatric Malpractice Attorney](https://www.zucker-regev.com/services/pediatric-malpractice-attorney): Pediatric medical malpractice lawsuits for negligent child medical care.
- [Compartment Syndrome Lawyer](https://www.zucker-regev.com/services/compartment-syndrome-lawyer): Medical malpractice lawsuits for compartment syndrome misdiagnosis and negligence.
